video_selection.policy: Use the twelve named formal core slots regardless of their outcome. Preserve full recorded source duration, short/long occlusion, hover, explicit selection and failures. Do not substitute a successful seed for an unsuccessful or unavailable clip. Missing video remains listed with its slot outcome and reason; any development illustration must be separately labelled and is not a replacement formal clip.
video_selection.transcoding: H.264 browser copies only after source hash, frame count, duration and per-frame relative timing are checked with build_browser_demos.py. Original video remains immutable.

detection_review_selection.policy: Use both named formal recordings regardless of engineering outcome. Preserve all sampled opportunities and explicit exclusion reasons. Review actual images against the independent geometric projection; approve only the declared fully visible in-frame subset. Never turn amodal projected boxes into unreviewed visible labels. Missing recording or insufficient review remains incomplete, without replacing the seed.
detection_review_selection.claim_boundary: Precision/Recall/mAP describe the independently reviewed, fully visible synthetic subset only. Online FPS and simulation/wall latency use the complete flight reports and remain separate. This subset does not establish detector accuracy over all 280 flights, occlusions or real scenes.

scope: Delivery sampling decisions only. No held-out seed was run or inspected to choose these slots; this file does not register navigation gates, replay parameters or authorize a formal flight.
